variant_decisions.evidence: Qere וּצְנִ֥יף and ketiv וצנוף are the same lexeme (6797); OSHB parses the qere as a construct noun and the ketiv as a qal infinitive absolute of the same root, but in construct with מְלוּכָה both yield the headdress. ASV "and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God" renders either reading, and no note is mapped here.
